exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки. Заполните пропуски, используя used to … .
Напишите предложения о Карен, используя used to … .

items.prompt: Do you do any sport? Yes, I swim every day and I play volleyball.
answers: She used to swim every day.

items.prompt: Do you do any sport? Yes, I swim every day and I play volleyball.
Do you go out much? Yes, most evenings.
answers: She used to go out most evenings.
She used to go out a lot.

items.prompt: Do you play a musical instrument? Yes, the guitar.
answers: She used to play the guitar.

items.prompt: Do you like reading? Yes, I read a lot.
answers: She used to read a lot.

items.prompt: Do you travel much? Yes, I go away two or three times a year.
answers: She used to go away two or three times a year.
She used to travel a lot.

items.prompt: Раньше у меня была собака. Теперь у меня кошка.
answers: I used to have a dog. Now I have a cat.

items.prompt: Моя дочь раньше играла на гитаре.
answers: My daughter used to play the guitar.

items.prompt: Раньше Борис не ел рыбу. Теперь он её любит.
answers: Boris didn’t use to eat fish. He loves it now.

items.prompt: Где вы работали до того, как стали учителем?

items.prompt: У нас не было большого дома, когда мы жили в Лондоне.
answers: We didn’t use to have a big house when we lived in London.
